## Reviewer Checklist

### UI / UX
- [ ] All Grid header column names are visible.
- [ ] Grid column header font size is slightly larger than cell text
- [ ] Tooltips are added where necessary
- [ ] No unnecessary large blank spaces
- [ ] No grammatical or typo errors
- [ ] Button colors follow the DNA template
- [ ] Page loader is implemented where needed
- [ ] UI controls do not overlap
- [ ] Form fields are validated appropriately
- [ ] Validate form fields and required fields.

### Code / Architecture
- [ ] Code structure is appropriate (Models, Services, Components)
- [ ] Service lifetimes are appropriate
- [ ] Caching is used appropriately and reviewed.
- [ ] Long UI load times have been reviewed and justified.(Is the user having to wait extended periods of time for no reason? or why do we have to wait?)

### Testing
- [ ] Unit testing is completed or updated where applicable

### Documentation / CI-CD
- [ ] Documentation is completed within GitHub
- [ ] Required CI/CD secrets and variables are configured or updated
